AP475 Stick Light — APKINA

A 12W RGB stick light with an integrated battery, adjustable colour temperature and 21 lighting effects.

SPECIFICATIONS
Power: 12W
Built-in battery: 5200mAh, 3.7V
Colour temperature: 2500–9900K, adjustable
Colour adjustment: 0–360° full colour gamut
Lighting effects: 21
Luminous flux: 1200 lm
Beam angle: 120°
Lighting distance: 3–5m
LED beads: 225
Weight: 320g
Dimensions: 420 × 41 × 38mm
Shell material: Aluminium alloy + ABS plug + PC cover

PACKAGING
Colour box dimensions: 515 × 55 × 51mm
Packing quantity: 25 pieces
Full box weight: 14kg
Outer box dimensions: 540 × 290 × 295mm
